# Author-source validation report

Scope: 161 datasets and 175 registered contrasts; `macaque_snrna` is explicitly excluded. Each ledger row carries its own review date. Completion of recorded audit checks does not imply full scientific verification.

## Scientific verification

These are detailed author-reproduction classifications, retained separately from the primary internal-QC and author-concordance badges. See `../quality/QUALITY_REPORT.generated.md` and `../quality/assessments.generated.json` for the current processing-quality decisions and individual checklists.

| Evidence claim | Datasets |
|---|---:|
| Fully verified | 0 |
| Author results compared, limits remain | 37 |
| Author effects reconstructed | 4 |
| Author results untested | 88 |
| No comparison evidence | 0 |
| Unresolved, review required | 32 |
| Verification in progress | 0 |
| Outside verification scope | 1 |

| Author-result availability | Datasets |
|---|---:|
| Author results accessible; see comparison scope | 47 |
| Author result file located; retrieval not confirmed | 0 |
| Only partial or non-equivalent author results available | 52 |
| Comparable author results not located in reviewed sources | 48 |
| Author-result access blocked or restricted | 14 |
| Author-result availability not yet reviewed | 0 |
| Not assessed: outside scope | 1 |

Full verification requires explicit contrast-level sign-off, byte/content source evidence, exact output trace, and comparable author results with no unresolved cohort, effect, statistical, or coverage limitations. A high correlation, a selected gene, a source checksum, or a completed checklist is insufficient. Unreviewed availability is not recorded as unavailable data. Unavailable data is not recorded as a mismatch. See the application Data verification workflow page and the per-dataset reasons/next steps in the TSV.

Comparability is documented separately for samples/replication, biological contrast, gene identifiers and tested universe, effect definition, statistical inference, and reference coverage. These are mandatory scientific requirements, not weighted points. Every record identifies the result being checked, author reference, criteria, limitations and conclusion. A separate author-method reconstruction does not verify the registered Explorer output by inheritance. Missing author P/FDR values are unassessed, not nonsignificant; selected tables and empty significant sets do not establish full-universe agreement.

The status levels are intentionally not interchangeable. `Processed source match` means the local processed input matches the author-deposited source. `Author result match` requires a direct comparison with an author result table. `Pipeline output trace` independently verifies that each published bundle row came from the committed local analysis table.

Downloaded manuscripts, supplementary workbooks, and author notebooks used in continued manual review are byte-pinned in `continued-sources/README.md`.

## Pathway rebuild and provenance checks

Cache-isolated FGSEA outputs were rebuilt and schema-3 provenance/checksums verified for 160 datasets and 174 registered contrasts. The changes below compare with pre-audit local outputs; they are not author-result comparisons and do not change the validation statuses above.

143 datasets use Git baseline commit `25cb4827a7385181e3fd09713be39ebda80ca13c`. 17 dataset(s) use a hash-pinned pre-migration local snapshot because no committed baseline exists.

- [GSE281503](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE281503): Pre-migration local snapshot: the original processed files dated 2026-08-31 are in a Git-ignored dataset directory and have no committed baseline. These copies were captured before the cache-isolated FGSEA rebuild; they are local pipeline outputs, not author-generated pathway results.
- [GSE317867](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE317867): Initial post-migration reference for a September 5 intake study, computed with the corrected schema-3 workflow. | [GSE284408](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE284408) | Review required | Published selection is inconsistent: 289 genes meet the stated rule, Table S1 lists 299, and the narrative reports 389. Ten below-cutoff Table S1 genes are listed for review. Author-method sensitivity success does not verify the registered edgeR discovery set or equate FPKM-ratio effects with fitted coefficients. All six GEO/count libraries match: three male NCD and three HFD laser-captured ARC regions enriched with Kiss1 neurons, not isolated single cells. Fresh deposited bytes equal the local input (SHA-256 dbb72325...). The 22,322 author effect values equal log2(HFD/NCD FPKM group means), maximum delta 5.2e-14; these are not DESeq2 fitted coefficients. A separate untuned group-only DESeq2 sensitivity reproduces all 19 author FDR<.05 IDs, with maximum FDR delta 2.2e-11 and raw-P delta 3.5e-7 across 18,169 finite tests. The author exports P/FDR=1 for 4,153 positions that are NA in the refit (4,145 all-zero and eight nonzero count rows), so missingness coding is not identical. Two such rows occur in the registered output; Bpifa1 has local nominal P<.05 and must not be treated as confirmed author-negative. The registered edgeR result remains 14,174 rows and seven FDR calls, all seven shared with the author. The paper's nominal-P<.05 and 1.5-fold rule yields 289 author genes (164 up/125 down), including 48 outside the local filter. The literal exported values give 241 author/284 registered/219 shared paper-rule calls. Restricting to 14,172 model-inferred evaluable rows gives 241/283/219; both scopes are retained. Table S1 instead contains 299 genes, including ten below the stated fold cutoff, while the narrative says 389 despite its components summing to 289. These source selection inconsistencies need review; they are not missing author data. Reproducible evidence, cohort mapping, per-gene outputs and hashes: continued-sources/five-dataset-followup-2026-09-04/GSE284408/. 2026-09-05 advancement: 14,174 finite matched effects from 22,322 author numeric effects; Pearson 0.92734069, Spearman 0.92168175, nonzero direction agreement 91.490%, median absolute log2FC difference 0.026989, paired RMS effect ratio 0.928157. Full author result table for the registered contrast. Cohort, source and author inference are supported. Published selection inconsistencies and registered effect/inference differences still require review. Missing author adjusted P remains unavailable; full local discovery counts and finite paired tests are reported separately. Numerical values are recalculated from the unchanged current registered DE table. Evidence and reproducible extraction are in continued-sources/advancement-sources-a-2026-09-05/GSE284408/. |

Direct publisher downloads returned HTTP403; indexed official methods and full GEO data were accessible. The exact historical formula/filter/offset/shrinkage code was not located. The deposited author CSV is a 24,405-row four-contrast union with 13,989 finite KO-versus-WT IP effects/FDRs. A separate, fixed raw-count DESeq2 genotype-only reconstruction reproduces every author-finite effect within 0.000447 log2FC. On 13,836 paired-finite FDRs, author 1,048 versus reconstruction 1,045 calls overlap at 1,045 (Jaccard 0.997137); missing FDRs are uncomparable. The paper (Methods 5.6.2/Figure 2) reports 3 chow-sedentary, 3 chow-running, 4 HFD-sedentary and 4 HFD-running RNA libraries. Official GEO SOFT/RAW.tar instead contain 3 CS, 3 HFS and 4 HFR, with no CR group (plus 8 miRNA-manipulation samples).
